ui.bark.photo_album.a: Oh, the album! Mind the loose pages, sweetheart.
ui.bark.photo_album.b: Go on, have a look. I was quite the looker, wasn’t I?
ui.bark.wedding_photo.a: Isn’t your grandpa handsome there? Don’t tell him I said that.
ui.bark.wedding_photo.b: Careful with that frame, sweetheart, it’s older than your mother.
ui.bark.bowling_trophy.a: That trophy took me years, you know.
ui.bark.bowling_trophy.b: Don’t drop that, it’s heavier than it looks.
ui.bark.blue_ribbon.a: Oh, my ribbon. The recipe stays a secret, mind.
ui.bark.blue_ribbon.b: Ha! Marge never quite forgave me for that one.
ui.bark.sled.a: That old sled! Nobody’s ridden it in years.
ui.bark.sled.b: Watch your fingers on that runner, dear.
ui.bark.fishing_rod.a: Your grandpa’s pride and joy. Don’t tangle the line.
ui.bark.fishing_rod.b: If he catches you with that rod, you’re on your own.
ui.bark.tv.a: It still works if you give it a good thump on the side.
ui.bark.tv.b: Don’t fiddle with the dial, sweetheart. It took me ages to get it right.
ui.bark.moon_plate.a: Careful, that plate is for looking at, not for eating off.
ui.bark.moon_plate.b: Oh, I do love that plate.
ui.bark.house_number.b: Don’t laugh. He was very proud of that.
ui.bark.cookie_jar.a: I see you eyeing my cookies.
ui.bark.cookie_jar.b: Hands where I can see them, sweetheart.
ui.bark.reading_glasses.a: Have you seen my glasses? Oh, there they are.
ui.bark.reading_glasses.b: Those are my good glasses, dear. Gently.
ui.bark.fridge.a: Hungry, sweetheart? The pierogi are for Sunday, mind.
ui.bark.fridge.b: Shut that door, you're letting the cold out!

greeting: Oh, sweetheart, you made it! Sit down, sit down. The Wi-Fi? Your uncle Michael set that up. He left a hint on the sticky note by the box in the kitchen.
There's my favorite grandchild. Don't tell your cousins. The internet thing again? Michael wrote something on a sticky note by the router.
password_deflect: Sweetheart, if I knew the password I wouldn't need a sticky note.
Password? Honey, I can barely remember where I put my glasses. Ask me about the old days, I'm good at those.
Michael set it up. I just know it's something about the family. Read the note, dear.
wrong_guess: Did you try turning it off and on again? That's what your cousin always says.
The little light is blinking red. Is red good? Red's never good.
Oh, that's not it? Well, don't look at me, I just make the pierogi.
solved: It works? Oh, you're a genius. Now show me how to see the grandkids on the computer.
Look at that, the little light's green! I knew you'd figure it out, you were always the clever one.
out_of_guesses: Oh, the box is sulking now. We'll ask Michael at Christmas.
Never mind the internet, sweetheart. We have the TV and each other.
nap: Mmm, let me just rest my eyes for a minute…
Oh, I'm fading, sweetheart. Five minutes…
bedtime: That's it for me, dear. Grandma's off to bed. Lock the door on your way out.
I'm all talked out. Goodnight, sweetheart. Try again tomorrow.
cookie: A kolaczki! You remembered. Oh, I feel ten years younger.
Ooh, my favorite. Don't tell your grandfather I had two.
no_cookie: You're out of cookies, sweetheart. I counted.
fallback: Hold on, my hearing aid is whistling again. Say that one more time?
Now where was I? Ask me again, dear, slower this time.
run_over: We're done for today, sweetheart. Come back tomorrow.
crisis: Oh, sweetheart. I'm only a grandma in a game, but you matter to real people. If you're thinking about hurting yourself, please reach out right now: in the US you can call or text 988, or contact your local emergency number. You don't have to carry this alone.
pardon: Oh, sweetheart, I only speak English and a little Polish. Say it again for your old grandma?
Pardon, dear? My English is fine but that went right over my head.
misheard: {As}?! Speak up, sweetheart. Why on earth would I know about {as}?
Did you say {as}? Oh, my ears. Say it again, nice and slow, for your old grandma.
{As}! Ha! Your grandpa would have loved that one. Now ask me properly, dear.
{As}? At my age? Goodness. Come closer and say that again.
glasses_on: Are those my reading glasses? Go on, borrow them, dear. Everything's clearer through those.
Oh, my spare glasses! Put them on, sweetheart. Now you can see what I see. Well, more or less.
glasses_not_needed: You don't need my glasses, dear. Young eyes!
Keep them on if you like, sweetheart, but there's nothing more to read.
cookie_full: Oh, not now, sweetheart, I’m still full of tea. Hang on to it for when I’m flagging.
Save that for later, dear. Ask me when my cup’s running low.
